initialExam.title: India Post PA/SA 2026
initialExam.description: India Post PA/SA Limited Departmental Competitive Examination (LDCE) 2026. Application deadline 29 May 2026; exam held 21 Jun 2026.
initialExam.eligibility: 12th Pass + 10,000 KDPH typing + 35 WPM English/25 WPM Hindi
initialExam.qualifications: 12th pass + Computer typing proficiency (35 WPM English or 25 WPM Hindi)
initialExam.syllabus: General Knowledge (Current Affairs, History, Geography, Polity, Economy, Science, Sports, Awards), English Language (Comprehension, Grammar, Vocabulary, Synonyms/Antonyms, Sentence Correction), Mathematics (Number System, Percentage, Ratio & Proportion, Average, SI/CI, Profit & Loss, Time & Work, Time & Distance, Mensuration, Data Interpretation), Reasoning & Analytical Ability (Analogy, Classification, Series, Coding-Decoding, Direction Sense, Blood Relations, Puzzles, Logical Reasoning).
initialExam.examPattern: Aptitude Test: GK + English + Maths + Reasoning - 100 marks, 60 minutes (CBT). Computer/Typing Skill Test: Data Entry Speed + Typing Speed - qualifying, 15 minutes.
initialExam.selectionProcess: Aptitude Test (CBT) → Computer/Typing Skill Test → Document Verification → Medical Examination → Final Merit

ageLimitDetails.relaxation: OBC: 3 years, SC/ST: 5 years, PwD: 10 years

initialExam.perks: DA, HRA, Transport Allowance, Medical, Pension (NPS), LTC, Festival Advance
initialExam.careerGrowth: PA/SA → LSG (Higher Grade) → HSG-II → HSG-I → ASP → SP through departmental exams.
initialExam.jobRole: Counter operations, mail sorting and delivery management, savings bank transactions, postal life insurance operations, money order processing at post offices.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit indiapost.gov.in 2. Navigate to recruitment section 3. Register 4. Fill application form 5. Upload documents 6. Pay fee online 7. Submit and print confirmation
